title: AssessmentQuestionCatgData - Data API
description: Stores category-level aggregated scores for an assessment. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

AssessedScore.description: Score assigned to the category for the evaluation.

AssessmentId.description: ID of the submitted assessment. This field is a relationship field.

MaximumScore.description: Maximum score derived from all applicable response choices for a question in the category, used as the denominator in percentage calculations.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Name of this assessment question category data.

QuestionCategory.description: Question category for which the aggregate score is calculated. Possible values are: Demographic Financial
